method: 16-nearest contour sample inverse-distance squared; three 2m smoothing passes. Interpolated, not surveyed. Modern construction grading requires separate provisional pads. Followed by constrained diffusion; original pad heights unchanged; source and iteration1 grid preserved.

smoothing.description: Constrained diffusion at 2m spacing; preserve all existing pad elevations and grid boundary. No vertical scaling.
